name: PGM on Carbon Support
description: Precious group metal (Pt, Pd, Ru) deposited on activated carbon via incipient wetness impregnation.
source: Jimenez et al., Industrial Catalyst Impregnation: Modern Equipment, Techniques, and Scaling Challenges, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 65, 12447 (2026)
route_note: The step list slurries the support and then filters, which is excess-solution practice, while the description says incipient wetness. Flagged rather than changed: deciding which one this template is meant to be is a chemistry call, not a cleanup.
